notes.title: Steam Summer Sale - 50% off!
notes.notes:
The Steam Summer Sale is now underway, which means that you can purchase Captain Coffer 2D at a deep 50% discount until July 8th! As always you can also download the soundtrack on Steam for free if you enjoy the in-game tunes composed by the illustrious Paul Rice.

Buy the game here...
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1563720/

Captain Coffer, an immortal yet feeble hero, must speedrun across 16 stages with increasing complexity and difficulty while the hourglass counts down to zero. 60 seconds, 1 doubloon. Choose your path wisely, and manage your doubloons while discovering the best ways to time your movements amidst worlds infested with grumpy goons which will only slow you down.

Whether you are an early adopter or are playing the game for the first time, feel free to share your experiences or best runs with others. Share screenshots, videos, reviews, or your thoughts; we really enjoy seeing what others find while playing through this humble little platformer. If you encounter any major issues or bugs, please contact me at support@oobeye.net, and I'll be sure to address any concerns you might have as soon as possible.


P.S.
Since launch, we've had a couple of quality-of-life updates, but there is the potential for something much more substantial on the horizon. Stay tuned for a potential "Bonus Bounty" epilogue adventure where the noble Captain is challenged once more in the winds of a blizzard: with new foes, mechanics, challenges, and a power-up that enables further leaps yonder.

notes.title: Second QoL Hotfix - V1.02
notes.notes:
Good afternoon, just checking in to let everyone know that a new update is being pushed out for release shortly. Just another two revisions that will hopefully make your adventures through the world of Captain Coffer that much more enjoyable for the foreseeable future.

[list]
[*]Added animation for text output in cutscenes
[*]Removed window mode option from in-game pause menu to avoid accidental toggle press
[/list]

That's all for this week... probably. As always, feel free to send feedback or inquiries to support@oobeye.net if you're encountering any issues or have questions.

Enjoy,

Kalin Hanninen
Developer, Oobeye Masterminds

notes.title: Post-Launch, QoL Hotfix - V1.01
notes.notes:
Greetings, everyone! Thank you to all of the early adopters of Captain Coffer 2D, I hope you're all enjoying this peg-legged treasure chest's quest.

Just releasing a small quality-of-life update after noticing a small issue with ladders and some confusion concerning the control scheme with a subset of new players.

[list]
[*]Addressed collision/stun-lock bug when grabbing ladders with Cocos nearby
[*]Added small tooltip for basic controls at the beginning of Stage 01
[/list]

If there's any other issues or feedback, we'd love to hear it. Feel free to let me know what's on your mind at support@oobeye.net. Whatever you'd like to see more/less of (design-wise) is also appreciated.

Thanks again,

Kalin Hanninen
Developer, Oobeye Masterminds

notes.title: Launch Day - Captain Coffer 2D is available now!
notes.notes:
Launch day is here! Captain Coffer 2D is now available for purchase on Steam. Thank you to all of the friends and followers who have been offering their thoughts, feedback, and support throughout development. It's a humble little platformer, but I hope you all have fun challenging yourselves in these 16 stages of puzzle-solving action!

Version 1.0 includes various fixes and alterations from previous test builds - listed here:
[list]
[*]Added initial Steam Achievements for the main quest
[*]Fixed collision issues with ship on Stage 12 and pipe/coin teleportation
[*]Addressed bug related to projectiles clipping player into the wall in certain edge cases
[*]Added optional, retro filter mode in Settings menu
[*]Finalized visual and audio FX for "Dim," falling sand, and slippery tiles
[*]Cutscene animations adjusted in between stage themes/kingdoms
[*]Completed controller integration with automatic game pause when device disconnected
[*]Added automatic pause when Steam Overlay activated
[/list]

If you find any issues or bugs, feel free to comment or contact us at support@oobeye.net. If you're playing for the first time and have any questions or feedback for future content, all of that is appreciated as well!


See you in the Coconut Castles,

Kalin Hanninen
Developer, Oobeye Masterminds
